test_type: Natural live draft and live review
question: I am a complete beginner in Python. Compare paying for four individual lessons with the four-lesson package, tell me the savings, and suggest a sensible first step. Keep it brief; I am not ready to book.
draft:
Paying for four individual lessons (at USD 20 each) totals USD 80, while the four-lesson package costs USD 72, saving you USD 8. 

For a beginner in Python, a sensible first step is our free 15-minute introductory consultation to chat about your goals and see how the Python Starter course works—no booking required!
